list: Official PS5 list: 55 trophies (1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze), 28 hidden. Names, descriptions and grades as PlayStation publishes them.

kg.name: KeenGamer – GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap (Ali Amir, 2026-11-19)

gb.name: GTABase – GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (updated 2026-11-18)

fx.name: Fextralife GTA VI Wiki – Trophy and Achievement Guide (edited 2026-11-19)

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops by itself the moment the other 54 trophies are in. Guides put the whole run near 200 hours on a single save: there is no difficulty setting, no New Game+ and no mission replay, and free roam stays open after the credits, so nothing beyond the Chapter 1 meditation spot is at real risk.
steps: Follow the roadmap stages in order.
Keep one manual save per chapter.
Never turn on cheats on your trophy save: they block trophies and saving for that session.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Gone Fishing is one of the first story missions of Chapter 1; finishing it awards this. Story progress cannot be skipped, so it cannot be missed.
steps: Play the opening of Chapter 1 until Gone Fishing ends.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Chapter trophies tend to arrive at the start of the next chapter rather than on the last mission's end screen. GTABase reports this one landing after What's in the Bag?, the first Chapter 2 mission. Do Lucia's balcony meditation before you leave Chapter 1 (see Positive Mental Attitude).
steps: Before the last Chapter 1 mission: meditate on Lucia's balcony.
Finish Chapter 1, then play What's in the Bag?.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Awarded as Chapter 3 begins, after the mission Welcome to Vice City according to GTABase. Purely story-locked.
steps: Finish Chapter 2's story missions.
Play Welcome to Vice City.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: GTABase reports it arriving after the first two missions of Chapter 4, not at the end of Chapter 3 itself. Chapter 3 opens most of the side strands (Yasmani, Andy, Randy, Yago), so start them before rushing on.
steps: Finish Chapter 3.
Play the first two Chapter 4 missions.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story-locked and unmissable. Near the end of Chapter 4 the optional mission That's Where The Money Is… opens the bank vaults; take it before you move on so the vault trophies can run in parallel.
steps: Finish every Chapter 4 story mission.
Pick up That's Where The Money Is… while you are there.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: One of the two golds, for the last story mission. Free roam carries on after the credits, so nothing is locked by finishing. Output Lag advises an untouched manual save just before the finale as insurance.
steps: Make a separate manual save before the final mission.
Finish the mission and watch the credits.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Breakfast Run is a Chapter 2 story mission. Output Lag notes that switching between Jason and Lucia becomes available right after it, which several partner trophies need.
steps: Play Chapter 2 until Breakfast Run is done.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: The Cartel Heist is a Chapter 3 story mission and pays this on completion. It cannot be skipped.
steps: Progress Chapter 3 until The Cartel Heist is complete.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Child's Play is a Chapter 4 story mission; the trophy comes when it ends.
steps: Complete Child's Play in Chapter 4.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Headliners is a Chapter 4 story mission. Story-locked, unmissable.
steps: Complete Headliners in Chapter 4.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: VCIA Takedown is a Chapter 4 story mission at the airport. Not to be confused with Catch Me If You Can, which needs a free-roam jet theft at the same airport.
steps: Complete VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Operation Savage Glory belongs to Chapter 5, the run-up to the finale. Finishing it pays the trophy.
steps: Complete Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The biggest job of the platinum, tracked on the in-game 100% checklist (roughly 100 hours on its own). Some lists must be done in full: every robbery (39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loans, 8 vaults), the underwater finds, all shooting range golds, all drone trials and Bret's 15 target decks. Others only need a share: 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 15 of 18 meditations, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts and 100 WAiNK scans. KeenGamer adds 15 of 18 card sets, 5 of 7 Kenton treasure sets, 100 of 125 flamingos and 30 of 40 races.
steps: Open the 100% checklist after the credits and sort by what is left.
Do the 'all of' lists first: robberies, shooting golds, drone trials, Bret's decks.
Fill the 'share of' lists last; several overlap with other trophies.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Any mix of stunt types counts. GTABase lists 130 stunt jumps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife-edge flights and 25 base jumps, so a helicopter or plane run over the rivers clears bridges fastest. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past the trophy.
steps: Grab a helicopter and clear bridges in bulk.
Do stunt jumps as you pass them on the map.
Aim for 300 to cover 100% as well.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Nine activity types, one try each. GTABase names them: fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball (score one basket), an arcade game, one won race (car race, race challenge or Top Fun) and one stunt.
steps: Fishing and arcade come early (Chapter 1).
Golf, pool, basketball: one session each.
Win any single race and land any stunt.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Called the hardest skill trophy by guides: 42 golds in total. GTABase spreads them over 12 ranges, while Output Lag speaks of two range locations, so the layout is unconfirmed; the 42 is agreed. Golds also raise your Focus, which makes Gunslinger easier, so do a few early.
steps: Run the easier challenges early for the Focus boost.
Retry for gold; there is no penalty for repeats.
The same 42 golds are required for 100%.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Fourteen drone race locations; one win at each is enough for the trophy. The 100% list asks for all 42 drone events, so finish every course at a location while you are there.
steps: Visit each of the 14 Top Fun spots.
Win one race per spot; clear all three for 100%.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Forty races qualify and each must be a different one: winning the same race twice does not add to the count. KeenGamer's 100% list wants 30 of the 40 anyway.
steps: Tune a fast car before racing.
Win 20 distinct races; go to 30 for 100%.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, Cal sends a text and marks a fishing spot on the map. Meet him there and out-fish him in the challenge.
steps: Finish Feng Shui.
Follow Cal's map marker and win his fishing challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Play any one arcade game through to its end. Three games run on the TV at home, and Bang For Your Buck sits in cabinets around Leonida, per GTABase.
steps: Use the home TV in Chapter 1.
Pick one game and finish it.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's strand is Lucia only: five missions that start in Belville from Chapter 3. The fifth awards the trophy. Output Lag notes Andy's strand does not count towards Strangers & Freaks.
steps: Switch to Lucia in Chapter 3.
Find Andy in Belville and play all five missions.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton sends you treasure hunting: recover the loot from 7 shipwrecks, tracked under Kenton's Treasures, then finish his last mission once he gets back in touch. Output Lag says side strands like this stay open after the credits.
steps: Start Kenton's strand when it appears.
Dive the 7 wrecks (Kenton's Treasures tab).
Wait for his follow-up and play the finale.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's five jobs begin at the Thrillbilly Mudclub once the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break is done; the fifth pays the trophy. Not one of the strands that counts for Strangers & Freaks.
steps: Finish Coffee Break.
Go to Thrillbilly Mudclub and clear Billy's five jobs.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.missNote: Output Lag calls Race Against Yago (Chapter 3) time-sensitive. Do it when it appears.
trophies.guide: Only some strands count. GTABase confirms Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete, and rules out Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie; the rest are still unconfirmed. Output Lag flags Race Against Yago in Chapter 3 as time-sensitive, so take it as soon as it shows up. Both roadmaps leave the remaining strands for the cleanup after the 100% checklist.
steps: Chapter 3: play Race Against Yago straight away.
Finish the Kirk, Kyle and Pilot Pete strands.
Clear other stranger icons until the count reaches 8.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's car orders open after the Chapter 3 mission Key Cloner. Deliver 16 sports cars to his garage in west Vice City; the last delivery mission pays the trophy.
steps: Finish Key Cloner.
Steal and deliver the 16 cars Randy asks for.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's strand is Jason only. Destroy the synthetic drug labs he marks in purple, then take his last job for the trophy. It does not count for Strangers & Freaks.
steps: Play as Jason.
Wreck every purple-marked lab.
Finish Tyrone's final job.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missNote: Lucia's balcony meditation the morning after Down to Earth is only there in Chapter 1. Guides do not know yet whether the trophy needs it: do it to be safe.
trophies.guide: The only trophy guides call possibly missable. In Chapter 1, the morning after Down to Earth, Lucia can meditate on her balcony; that spot is gone after Chapter 1. It is unconfirmed whether it counts towards the 18, so do it anyway. GTABase notes that, after Coffee Break, meditating at one spot as both Jason and Lucia counts twice.
steps: Chapter 1, after Down to Earth: meditate on Lucia's balcony.
After Coffee Break, use spots with both characters.
Fill the rest during the 100% cleanup (15 of 18 for 100%).

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret's hunting strand opens after Coffee Break with Veteran Hunted in Lummox County, and is Jason only per Output Lag. Which unique animal pops the trophy is not confirmed yet; working through Bret's 15 target decks covers it, and all 15 are needed for 100% anyway.
steps: After Coffee Break, start Veteran Hunted.
Clear Bret's target decks in order.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Any three card sets, finished in full, earn the silver. KeenGamer's 100% list asks for 15 of the 18 sets, so the trophy comes naturally during the cleanup.
steps: Pick the three smallest sets first.
Keep collecting towards 15 of 18 for 100%.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app on landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and No Flusher tags; any 100 count. 100 WAiNK scans are also part of the 100% list, so do them while you drive around.
steps: Open WAiNK whenever a landmark or tag is nearby.
Mix types; any 100 locations count.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Challenges live under Progress > Challenges in the pause menu. Fifty pay the trophy; the 100% checklist wants 70 of the 80.
steps: Check Progress > Challenges for easy ones.
Reach 50, then 70 for 100%.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Available after Coffee Break. A bank vault job always starts at four stars, which makes it the easiest trigger. Have your partner with you and keep going until you leave the red search zone; the trophy only pops then.
steps: Bring your partner.
Rob a vault (instant 4 stars).
Escape fully out of the red zone.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Three robberies in a row with your partner, staying wanted the whole time. GTABase suggests the three jewelry stores in north Vice City, which open after Yasmani's Chapter 3 jobs. Output Lag says the trophy can take around 30 seconds to appear.
steps: Finish Yasmani's jewelry jobs.
Hit the three north Vice City stores back to back.
Do not lose the stars between shops.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: You do not need to drive them: a WAiNK scan of a vehicle counts as discovering it. 100 pays the trophy; the 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 models.
steps: Scan traffic with WAiNK at busy junctions.
Keep going to 200 for 100%.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is L3+R3 while aiming. Fill the Focus bar first; shooting range golds raise it. Gang thugs count, police, soldiers and civilians seem not to (GTABase). An assault rifle against a group of gang members works well.
steps: Raise Focus at a shooting range.
Find a cluster of gang members.
Aim, press L3+R3, drop five before it ends.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a big passenger jet that is docked at a boarding bridge at Vice City International and fly it about a kilometre away. Gates E3 and E4 are named as the easiest. The pop is delayed, and the heat is intense, so save first.
steps: Manual save.
Board a docked jet at gate E3/E4.
Take off and fly roughly 1 km out.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Guides read this as stealing a Rhino tank and fighting with it. Rhinos are parked at Mile Zero Air Station in Mariana County, on its south side according to Output Lag. The exact trigger is still unconfirmed, so cause some damage before you leave the tank.
steps: Go to Mile Zero Air Station.
Take a Rhino.
Use it in combat until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Yasmani's Chapter 3 jewelry jobs hand you the Snap Gun. Open the back door with it rather than kicking it in, which trips the alarm. GTABase recommends Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds for this.
steps: Get the Snap Gun from Yasmani.
Pick the back door of Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds.
Loot unseen and leave.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Vaults open through the optional mission That's Where The Money Is… near the end of Chapter 4. Five of the eight vaults are enough; each pays up to $205,000, and all eight are needed for 100%. Bring your partner so Hot Together and A Classic Blitz Play can come along.
steps: Take That's Where The Money Is… in Chapter 4.
Rob a vault with your partner and fully escape.
Repeat for 5 (all 8 for 100%).

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and get clear. It only pops once you leave the red heat zone. GTABase reports that a bank vault robbery also unlocks it if you escape or reach a Pay 'n' Spray.
steps: Hit an armored truck (or a vault).
Lose the heat completely.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Clear the fog from the whole map. Flying over the unrevealed areas is the quickest way, according to GTABase.
steps: Get a helicopter or plane.
Fly a grid over every fogged area of the map.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Nine gangs run illegal operations; one robbery from each gang is enough. The 100% list wants all 39 operations, so note which gang each one belongs to as you go.
steps: Rob operations as they appear on the map.
Cover all 9 gangs; finish all 39 for 100%.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: No guide has a confirmed method yet. The description points to buying a drink at a bar or terrace on Ocean Beach with a sea view. Try the beachfront bars there, and check back once guides confirm it.
steps: Visit Ocean Beach bars with a view.
Order a cocktail; note what worked.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed at launch. GTABase reads it as taking a car from a dealership and crashing it out through the showroom window, a nod to older games in the series. Save before you try.
steps: Find a vehicle showroom.
Drive a display car through the front glass.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: The alley is Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, a gang operation marked during Chapter 2. Take the valuables (a watch, a shotgun and a safe) and get away from the police. KeenGamer implies all three are needed; GTABase says not in a single visit. Output Lag suggests packing Sticky Bombs and says it is not missable.
steps: Bring Sticky Bombs.
Raid Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn.
Grab the valuables and lose the police.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Raise Strength to the maximum for both Jason and Lucia. Training one of them at a fitness club trains the other too, and home training works after the story, per GTABase.
steps: Buy a gym membership.
Train together until both bars are full.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.missNote: GTABase warns the Irredeemable criminal profile is permanent. Not a missable trophy, but avoid it.
trophies.guide: Five hundred actions that change your Criminal Profile; robberies and fights count, so it fills during normal play. GTABase warns that the Irredeemable profile cannot be undone.
steps: Just play: robberies and fights add up.
Keep an eye on your profile to avoid Irredeemable.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Method not confirmed by any guide at launch. GTABase reads the description as succeeding at something on a second attempt. Mark it here when you find the trigger.
steps: Unknown: watch for retry-style events.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Method not confirmed. GTABase suspects a strange event or Easter egg somewhere in Leonida; the name hints at something extraterrestrial. Explore remote areas at night.
steps: Unknown: look for odd events in remote areas.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Guides agree it means taking people down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle (for example from a bike), but the exact count and setup are not confirmed yet.
steps: Ride a bike or ATV past a group.
Use the melee attack while moving.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: A running total, not one sale. Bank jobs and payday loan robberies give Marked Bills; sell them to fences. GTABase says the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check with Raul's crew gives the Dye Pack Jammer, and that Yasmani pays the best rate.
steps: Finish Credit Check for the Dye Pack Jammer.
Rob banks and payday loans.
Launder through Yasmani until $250,000.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Cumulative spending across all shop types. Guns, car modifications and tattoos drain money fastest, per GTABase. Vault money from Chapter 4 makes it quick.
steps: After a few vaults, buy guns and car mods.
Track the running total here.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Eight garages are for sale in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver; together about $160,000. Garages the story gives you do not count. Extra garage space also helps On the Spot.
steps: Finish Daily Driver.
Buy all 8 garages in the Real Estate app.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Moses' Chapter 2 mission unlocks the Scooter Bros app; take stolen cars to his garage in Port Gellhorn to register them. From Chapter 3 any Pay 'n' Spray can register a tracked car. Each registration costs money and needs a free garage slot.
steps: Finish Moses' Chapter 2 mission.
Register 10 cars at Moses' garage or a Pay 'n' Spray.
Free up garage space first.
